verified: 1618 Safavid holds ARM (Yerevan) — confirmed by Treaty of Serav, 26 Sept 1618, ending the 1616-18 Ottoman-Safavid war on terms restoring the 1612 Nasuh Pasha line (Persia keeps the Caucasus).
1618 Brandenburg gains PRS (ducal Prussia) as a Polish fief on the death of Albert Frederick — correct year for the Hohenzollern union.

1629 Bavaria holds RHE (Rhine Palatinate) alongside BAV, reflecting Maximilian I's 1623 grant of the Upper Palatinate and electoral title, with the Lower/Rhine Palatinate under Bavarian-Spanish occupation after Frederick V's exile.
1629 Sweden gains LVA (Livonia) and Poland-Lithuania loses it — Truce of Altmark, Sept 1629, correct.

1629 Ottoman and Safavid regions correctly reflect Baghdad's loss to Persia in 1624 (MES_S moves to safavid) and its return to Ottoman hands only from the 1648 slice on, consistent with the Treaty of Zuhab (1639).
1648 Portugal reappears as an independent entity (Braganza Restoration, 1640) holding POR_N/POR_S, correctly split from Spain.
1648 Venice's Crete siege (Candia, contested) begins exactly at this slice and the entity notes it will run '21 years' — matches the historical 1648-1669 siege precisely.
1660 Sweden keeps Skåne (SWE_S) per the Peace of Copenhagen (May 1660), consistent with Roskilde 1658 and the wider Second Northern War outcome.
1667 Truce of Andrusovo (Jan) correctly moves the left bank (UKR_E) and DON-area gains to Russia; Poland retains right-bank UKR_W.
1683 Ottoman siege of Vienna and Sobieski's relief at Kahlenberg (12 Sept) dated correctly; AUT/SVK correctly marked contested.
1699 Treaty of Karlowitz transfers HUN and TRN to austria_habsburg, PEL (Morea) to Venice, and clears Poland's VOL contested flag (Podolia/Kamianets regained) — all correct and well-timed.
1699/1714 Crimean Khanate's loss of DON (Azov, 1696) and its recovery plus STE (Zaporozhian Sich relocation to Oleshky after Poltava) at 1714 are both historically accurate and unusually precise.

Founding years for episodic/regional entities (moldavia 1346, wallachia 1330, ottoman 1299, safavid 1501, austria_habsburg 1282, brandenburg 1157, sweden 1523, russia 1263, poland_lithuania 1569, morocco 1631) all match the brief's canonical registry.
Bohemia's disappearance as an independent entity from the 1629 slice onward (crown absorbed into Austria_habsburg after White Mountain, 1620) is correctly timed.

Transylvania's transfer from its own entity to austria_habsburg's regions happens only at 1699 (Karlowitz), not earlier at the 1691 Diploma Leopoldinum — a defensible slice-year choice given no intervening slice exists.

Great Britain entity (1714) correctly formed at the 1707 Act of Union, absorbing Scotland's regions; population figures for England/Britain and Ireland's split between english/Confederate Ireland (1648) are within plausible ranges.
